manifest.name: channel-inbox-event
manifest.description: Append-only inbox of provider-verified channel webhook deliveries, one row per (space, connection, provider event id) (backlog:e5532d1c9146). Generalizes the M11 signature inbox to any channel adapter: verification before any write, DB-unique event identity plus payload fingerprint, quarantine for unknown subjects, an explicit effect per row, and a stable refusal that echoes nothing. Rows stored by the progressive initial history import carry that import's importKey (null for webhook rows), so a replayed page derives stored-by-this-import instead of recounting it.

migrations.name: create_channel_inbox_events

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_channel_inbox_events
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."channel_inbox_events" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "connection_key" TEXT,
  "import_key" TEXT,
  "adapter" TEXT,
  "adapter_version" BIGINT,
  "provider_event_id" TEXT,
  "subject" TEXT,
  "payload_fingerprint" TEXT,
  "sequence" BIGINT,
  "occurred_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "received_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "processed" BOOLEAN,
  "effect" TEXT CHECK("effect" IN ('pending', 'applied', 'ignored', 'quarantined', 'duplicate')),
  "effect_reason" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "channel_inbox_events_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."channel_inbox_events"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "channel_inbox_events_connection_key"
  ON "accordo"."channel_inbox_events"("connection_key");

CREATE INDEX "channel_inbox_events_import_key"
  ON "accordo"."channel_inbox_events"("import_key");

CREATE INDEX "channel_inbox_events_provider_event_id"
  ON "accordo"."channel_inbox_events"("provider_event_id");

CREATE INDEX "channel_inbox_events_subject"
  ON "accordo"."channel_inbox_events"("subject");

CREATE INDEX "channel_inbox_events_processed"
  ON "accordo"."channel_inbox_events"("processed");
